title: Mysterious Creature Spotted in Mexico 2026 Viral Photos in Juarez Valley Fact check news
excerpt: Photos of a strange creature in Juarez Valley, Mexico have gone viral, leading to discussions that it may be an alien. However, scientific verification has yet to be obtained.
content:
Mexico Mysterious Creature: Alien on the Mexico-US Border? Discover the Exact Truth

international news: Currently, photos of a strange and previously unseen creature are going viral on social media. This creature has been found on the border between the US and Mexico, leading to speculation that it may be an alien. But what is the exact truth? 

In the Juarez Valley area of Chihuahua state in Mexico, photos and videos of a strange creature have gone viral on social media, sparking discussions. Captured by a camera trap in October 2026, this creature is said to have a white or pale color, and it is reported to have no hair on its body with long limbs and tail. Mexican UFO researcher Jaime Maussan has named this creature 'El Ser Del Valle De Juarez.' According to their claims, this creature is about 1.8 meters, or 6 feet long, and is agile and intelligent. However, these claims have not yet received independent scientific verification.

It is reported that Maussan and his team presented photos from the camera trap during a press conference held on October 17, 2026. These photos allegedly show a strange-looking creature climbing a wall. Its length has been estimated by comparing it to the size of bricks on the wall. Since July 2026, three different sightings have been reported, and some farmers have claimed that chickens, roosters, and rabbits in the area have gone missing. Some have referred to this creature as a 'humanoid predator' or chupacabra. However, these claims have not yet been substantiated.

The local administration's stance on this matter appears to be different. It has been noted that the Juarez Civil Protection Department and local administration have not received any official complaints regarding such a dangerous creature or a large number of animal deaths. There has also been no confirmation of official reports regarding such creatures in the El Paso area of Texas, USA. Therefore, there is no solid basis for discussions about a mysterious predatory creature roaming the area. Additionally, there is no evidence that any government or scientific institution has recognized this creature as a new species.

Several questions arise regarding these claims. Since Maussan has previously made controversial claims about UFOs and aliens, independent verification of his new claims is deemed necessary. The exact identification of the creature cannot be determined from the available photographs. It cannot be ruled out that it could be an ordinary animal, a sick creature, or one with physical deformities. There is no solid evidence of DNA testing, scientific examination, or verification by independent experts available.
